label: PF Backlog 149
title: Guaranteed guarded run: every entry point (CLI + dashboard) goes through core.run_entry
body: New core/run_entry.py — begin_run(project) stops any other instance (run_guard), acquires the lock WITH a minted run id, back-fills run linkage, and reconciles already-approved stages; end_run releases. scripts/run_pipeline.py now routes through begin_run (accepts --run-id) and the executor adopts the lock's run id. dashboard/server.py _spawn_run registers the run id up front, refuses if a run is already active, and passes --run-id (returns run_id to the UI). execute_pipeline() now REFUSES to run without a held run lock (bypass guard; PIPELINE_ALLOW_UNGUARDED=1 overrides), so no path can run unguarded/unstamped.

dashboard_impact.reason: Dashboard shows/uses the run_id from /api/run and the active-run state.

_note: core/run_entry.py (begin_run/end_run/active) is the ONE guarded entry point. run_pipeline.py routes through begin_run (--run-id, executor adopts lock run id). dashboard/server.py _spawn_run mints/registers run id, refuses if active, passes --run-id, returns run_id. execute_pipeline() refuses without a held lock (PIPELINE_ALLOW_UNGUARDED=1 override). Verified: begin_run acquired lock w/ run id; unguarded execute refused; lock cleanly released.
